purpose: Acquires transcripts for YouTube videos by pulling native captions (preferring json3 format ASR tracks) and falls back to WhisperX GPU transcription when no English caption track exists. Each video gets a JSON sidecar file containing the transcript source and timestamp-aligned segments.

public_api.name: pull_subtitles
public_api.role: Pulls captions for one video from YouTube via yt-dlp; prefers json3 and falls back to VTT. Returns the local caption file path or None.

public_api.name: parse_json3
public_api.role: Parses a YouTube json3 caption file into a list of {start, end, text} segments with times in seconds. Used when a json3 file is downloaded.

public_api.name: parse_vtt
public_api.role: Parses a WebVTT caption file into {start, end, text} segments. Used as fallback when json3 is unavailable.

public_api.name: whisperx_fallback
public_api.role: Runs WhisperX coarse-pass transcription on a GPU when no English caption exists. Returns segment list or None. GPU-only; logs and returns None if CUDA unavailable.

public_api.name: acquire_transcript
public_api.role: Orchestrates the full transcript acquisition pipeline: tries YouTube captions first, falls back to WhisperX. Returns {source, segments} dict or None if unresolved.

public_api.name: run_stage2
public_api.role: Main batch processor: acquires transcripts for all candidate videos and writes per-video JSON sidecars. Blocks (raises) when failure fraction exceeds 50% threshold, both mid-batch and at end.

public_api.name: main
public_api.role: Entry point when run as a module (python -m scraper.stage2_transcripts).
